nodes.title: Operating Countries
nodes.summary: ZX Bank operates across five South Asian countries: India (full-service retail, corporate and digital banking), Sri Lanka (25+ branches for SME, personal banking and remittance corridors), Bangladesh (regional partner for mobile banking and microfinance), Bhutan (cross-border banking, digital onboarding, NRI support) and Nepal (digital kiosks and remittance services).

nodes.title: Services Offered
nodes.summary: ZX Bank's product lines span retail banking (savings/current accounts, personal and home loans, credit cards, fixed deposits), corporate banking (business loans, trade finance, treasury), digital banking (mobile app, NetBanking/UPI, e-KYC, AI chatbot), remittances and wealth management (investment advisory, mutual funds, NRI services).

children.title: Retail Banking
children.summary: Retail banking products are savings and current accounts, personal and home loans, credit cards, and fixed deposits.

children.title: Corporate Banking
children.summary: Corporate banking offering covers business loans, trade finance, and treasury solutions.

children.title: Digital Banking
children.summary: Digital banking includes the ZX Bank Asia mobile app on Android and iOS, NetBanking and UPI, e-KYC, and an AI chatbot.

children.title: Remittances
children.summary: Remittance services provide rapid cross-border payments across India, Sri Lanka, Nepal, and Bhutan.

children.title: Wealth Management
children.summary: Wealth management offerings are investment advisory, mutual funds, and NRI services.

nodes.title: Branch & ATM Network
nodes.summary: Network scale by country: India 560+ branches and 1,200+ ATMs, Sri Lanka 32 branches / 40 ATMs, Bangladesh 18 / 30, Bhutan 8 / 15, Nepal 20 / 35.

nodes.title: Key Management
nodes.summary: Key leadership team: CEO Anjali Deshmukh, CFO Rajiv Senanayake, CTO Dipendra Khadka, and South Asia Regional Director Meera Liyanage.

nodes.title: Mobile App: ZX Bank Asia
nodes.summary: The ZX Bank Asia mobile app is available on Android and iOS with balance check and fund transfer, bill payments, loan tracking, biometric login, QR scan pay, and the Zia AI financial assistant.

nodes.title: CSR & ESG Focus
nodes.summary: CSR and ESG work includes green finance (Bhutan hydropower, Nepal solar), financial literacy campaigns in rural India and Bangladesh, and women empowerment micro-loans across South Asia.
